SELECT 1 AS application_id , 1 AS responsibility_id , system_code , module_code , role_code , role_name , role_desc , TO_CHAR(apply_start_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS apply_start_date , TO_CHAR(apply_end_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS apply_end_date FROM LGCOM_ROLE_M a WHERE (apply_start_date IS NULL OR apply_start_date <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AND (apply_end_date is NULL OR apply_end_date >= TRUNC(SYSDATE))
AND system_code = #{systemCode}
AND module_code = #{moduleCode}
AND role_name LIKE #{roleName} || '%'
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM LGCOM_COMMON_CODE_C WHERE common_code = a.role_code AND code_type_code = 'LGCOM_SUPER_USER_EXCLUDE_ROLE' AND use_flag = 'Y' AND (apply_start_date IS NULL OR apply_start_date <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AND (apply_end_date IS NULL OR apply_end_date >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)))
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM LGCOM_USER_ROLE_N_V WHERE application_user_id = #{ownUserId} AND system_code = a.system_code AND module_code = a.module_code AND role_code = a.role_code)
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM LGCOM_PROGRAM_ACCESS_N WHERE program_id = #{ownPgmId} AND system_service_id = #{ownSvcId} AND role_code = a.role_code)
ORDER BY system_code, module_code, role_code
